event_description: Commonwealth Of Massachusetts Declaration Of Emergency Notice (Title 49 CFR 390.23). From FMCSA's copy: This emergency exemption is issued because of below average cold temperatures that have caused an increased demand for fuel throughout the Commonwealth.

Commonwealth of Massachusetts DoE Notice (Title 49 CFR § 390.23) Jan. 5, 2018. From FMCSA's copy: This emergency exemption is issued as a result of below average cold temperatures that have caused an increased demand for fuel throughout the Commonwealth.

Massachusetts Declaration of Emergency Notice 1.23.2026. From FMCSA's copy: The emergency exemption request is due to high demand as the result of recent and continuing colder temperatures, increased heating demand, and a multi-day storm event expected to impact the region late this weekend and Monday.

Massachusetts Declaration of Emergency Notice 2.6.2026. From FMCSA's copy: The emergency exemption request is due to high demand from the recent and continuing colder than normal temperatures resulting in increased heating demand, as well as a multi-day storm that impacted the region last weekend and continues to impede local deliveries.
